## Description

Formulates infinite-dimensional portfolio allocation optimization over a Wasserstein ambiguity set of continuous function distributions using neural operators.

## Where it may fit

High parameter uncertainty, infinite-dimensional function space macro allocation, structural economic shifts.

## Vehicles

Institutional Asset Management, Global Macro Hedge Funds, Pension Portfolios.

## Required data

Multi-asset historical return series, macroeconomic function curves, Wasserstein radius parameters.

## Caveats

Neural operator training requires high-resolution functional input spaces and robust GPU solvers.
